parts.title: Setting Up Camp
parts.text: At **dusk**, Jin, Olivia, and Hassan reached the campsite with their uncle. Hassan helped put up the tent. The poles were **sturdy**, so the wind could not knock it down. Olivia had to **rummage** through her bag to find the **lantern**.

parts.title: Fire Night
parts.text: Uncle lit a campfire. The logs began to **crackle** and pop. Jin pointed at one orange **ember** that floated up into the dark. The flames began to **flicker**, and a warm **glow** fell on all their faces.

parts.title: Night Sounds
parts.text: Soon the children crawled into their **snug** sleeping bags. In the **thicket** nearby, the frogs sang together in a **chorus**. Far away, an owl gave a long, low **hoot**. Hassan whispered, “I like it here.” Olivia said the stars looked like tiny lamps.

parts.title: Sleepy Time
parts.text: Uncle checked the fire one last time. Jin lay awake and listened. The night was full of small sounds. He was glad to be far from the city, and he fell asleep with a smile.
